question: As of March 2022, who is the chief justice of Karnataka high court?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ritu Raj Awasthi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ritu Raj Awasthi:**

 
 
• He was born on July 3, 1960.
 
• He is now the **22nd Law Commission of India's** **chairperson.**
 
• He **served as the Karnataka High Court's Chief Justice from October 11, 2021, to July 2, 2022**.
 
• He was a judge of the Allahabad High Court from April 13, 2009, to October 10, 2021.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Law Commission of India:**

 
 
• It is an **executive body** established by an order of the Government of India.
 
• It is **led by a retired judge** and consists of legal experts whose job it is to research and advise the government on legal reform.
 
• It **serves as an advisory body to the Ministry of Law and Justice** and is constituted for a set period of time.
 
• Lord Macaulay led the first Law Commission, which was founded by the East India Company in 1833 under the **Charter Act** of 1833, when India was still a colony.
 
• The **first Law Commission of independent India** had a three-year tenure** established in 1955.**
